compute_per_attr_map: compute per attribute mean AP from precision arrays and attribute-to-contiguous-id mappings
compute_per_attr_type_map: aggregate per attribute class APs into per attribute type APs using an attribute type mapping
heirachrichal_APs: compute hierarchical APs for object and object-part attributes from an LVIS evaluation object
get_mean_AP: compute mean average precision from a list of AP values filtering out invalid entries
get_AP_from_precisions: extract average precision for a given index from a precision array
